themes.consensus_view: Most banks see hyperscaler AI capex as the dominant engine of the rally, while a smaller skeptical camp warns the setup is priced to perfection and vulnerable if Nvidia earnings or momentum stalls.

facts_agreed.claim: Mega-cap US hyperscaler capex is accelerating into 2026 and is the primary driver of AI-linked equity demand.
evidence_quotes: consensus of analysts is now for the mega-cap US hyperscalers to spend $755 billion
major cloud service providers... are now at USD ~700bn—driving storage demand
U.S. market is benefiting extraordinarily from the AI capital expenditure (capex) boom.
appetite for semis/memory/AI-adjacent hardware continues to roar

facts_agreed.claim: Hyperscaler spending is feeding through to power, gas, storage and infrastructure suppliers beyond pure semis.
evidence_quotes: ET also announced an agreement to supply an initial 150 mmcf/d of gas supply
conversations with hyperscalers have signaled to higher gas demand than anticipated
Siemens Energy has experienced significant demand growth, particularly in its Gas Services business
We still expect numbers in the 6-7 Bcf/d range from data centers in the 2030s.
server demand (AI & Traditional) benefiting from AI-infrastructure buildouts

facts_agreed.claim: AI-related demand is supporting equity leadership in semiconductors and tech globally.
evidence_quotes: Equities were led by stocks linked to AI‑related investment
we continue to favor the European IT sector as it benefits from AI-related demand
The main driver remains global equity resilience, which is offsetting both higher oil prices
AI-linked themes across tech and semiconductors drove strong returns
number of Japanese firms pointing to AI-related demand as a reason for increased exports

facts_contested.claim: Whether the AI capex rally remains fundamentally supported or is priced to perfection and vulnerable to a stall.
facts_contested.for_evidence: hyperscalers have effectively become the capital engine of the global AI ecosystem
facts_contested.against_evidence: Self-Referential Positive Feedback Loop of current Equities leadership

facts_contested.claim: Whether incremental AI capex alone is enough, or monetization at the application layer must validate the spend.
facts_contested.for_evidence: recent developments in the tech field have reinforced our conviction in the long-term potential
facts_contested.against_evidence: incremental AI capex alone may not be sufficient; investors will likely focus more on monetization.

facts_contested.claim: Whether concentration in AI names is a strength of the rally or a downside risk if momentum fades.
facts_contested.for_evidence: appetite for semis/memory/AI-adjacent hardware continues to roar
facts_contested.against_evidence: concentration makes for an uncomfortable setup
